answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks through remote hardware attestation across an enclave orchard. Each agent must execute in certified silicon to generate cryptographic proofs rooted in vendor keys. Against a gale of forged identities, attackers must buy physical secure processors, incurring verifiable hardware capital costs per identity. This creates a steep cost canyon that emulators cannot cross. However, silicon side-channel leaks and centralized vendor keys remain key limitations.
